comment: Seed to Shelf: the AI impact case film (one grower's season, six cases, each closing on what the grower gains). Same fields as vo_script.json. Build with CUT=impact. Line ids use their own prefixes (x n l u k b g z). Lines whose words are on screen carry caption:false (only used by captioned cuts).

lines.text: A seedling that never comes up.
A harvest that misses the order.
A crate at the wrong store.
Impact isn't a promise. It's a result.
lines.tts: Impact isn't a promise... It's a result.

lines.text: At Eagerworks, every AI project starts with the result it has to deliver: less waste, more output, better decisions.
Here's one grower's season, from seed to shelf.
It starts in the nursery.
Cameras over the moving trays count and size every seedling, and flag weak trays early.
For the grower, more of every tray reaches the field, with less replanting, and planting that stays on schedule.
In the field, a camera on the tractor measures every lettuce.
The model forecasts the boxes ready each day, and matches them to the orders.
So the harvest is cut to the order: less lettuce thrown away, and every delivery arrives complete.
At harvest, every field needs its size split.
Off-the-shelf models missed onions, so a custom model over the windrower counts each one once, and sorts it by size.
lines.tts: Off-the-shelf models missed onions... so a custom model over the wind rower counts each one once, and sorts it by size.

lines.text: No more crews sampling by hand. Every field is planned, and sold, on its real sizes.
In the packhouse, every pumpkin is counted and graded for quality, with no hand counts.
Every pumpkin sells in the class it earned, and the team stops counting, and starts running the line.
At dispatch, one crate at the wrong supermarket means a rejection, and a fine.
AI recognizes each crate, checks the order, labels it, and holds back any mismatch.
The right crate reaches the right store, the first time. No fines, no returns, no product lost. Every rejection avoided keeps around fifteen hundred dollars in the business.
Finally, it all lands in one place.
One data foundation powers a live dashboard, self-building reports, and alerts while there's still time to act.
Ask in plain English, and the answer comes from live data.
Hours of reporting turn into minutes, and every decision rests on live data.
Six problems. Six results. One season.
lines.tts: Six problems... Six results... One season.

lines.text: Less waste, better prices, and faster decisions. That's how AI makes a whole industry more productive.
Eagerworks AI Studio.
Let's build what's next.
